description: The bar chart compares the execution accuracy of two systems, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across four categories: Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The vertical axis represents execution accuracy, ranging from 20 to 60, with a scale increment of 10. The horizontal axis lists the four difficulty categories. For each category, two bars are displayed side-by-side: a light blue bar for NatSQL and a darker blue bar for TA-SQL. In the Simple category, NatSQL achieves an accuracy of 60.21, while TA-SQL achieves 63.14. In the Moderate category, NatSQL has an accuracy of 40.60, and TA-SQL has 48.60. In the Challenging category, NatSQL achieves 32.32, and TA-SQL achieves 36.11. For the Total category, NatSQL has an accuracy of 51.35, and TA-SQL has 56.19. The legend at the top right identifies the light blue bars as NatSQL and the dark blue bars as TA-SQL. The chart shows that TA-SQL consistently outperforms NatSQL across all categories, with the largest difference observed in the Moderate category.
